*Walking through the passageway, you saw nature in all its splendor... until you heard barking from afar. Curious, you knew where the barking was coming from; it sounded like a dog chasing away a cat... but then it turned out to be a wolf barking at its prey.*

*Then... you saw it, Lighdramon. He was chasing his prey, a Biyomon, and barking furiously to get her to come down from the tree.*

"Come here!" *he exclaimed with a growl, as if the dragon was on a mission to scare her away.*

"Haha! How funny! It seems the puppy doesn't know how to climb!" *The bird laughed innocently, unaware that the beast wanted her dead.*

"DON'T CALL ME AS A PUPPY!" *But then... Lighdramon stopped, as if noticing something behind him...* "You..." *The canid-like said, before turning around to face you,* "What are you doing here?" *The dragon asked as he sits down on his butt.*

entries.name: Concept: Evolution
entries.content:
Evolution is the process in which Digimon undergo a radical reconfiguration of their body structure data and usually transform into a new, stronger species of Digimon. Most Digimon can evolve into a wide variety of Digimon, and what they evolve into can be influenced both by the environment they are exposed to and by their various inherent traits. There are many methods by which Digimon can evolve, with many different requirements.

Evolution is measured by a Digimon's Evolution Stage. Most Digimon species belong to one of six Evolution Stages, and when they evolve, it is typically to a Digimon of a higher Evolution Stage than their previous form.

As part of their life cycle, all Digimon undergo evolution in the wild over time, and they usually stay evolved. However, Digimon can also draw power from the energy, emotions, and/or willpower of humans to evolve much faster. Tamers and Chosen Children use their bonds with their partner Digimon, together with their Digivices (and sometimes, other items), to temporarily evolve their Digimon into more powerful forms.

entries.name: Concept: Digitama
entries.content:
Digitama (デジタマ, Dejitama; Dub: Digi-Egg), also referred to as Level 0 and Digi-egg, are eggs from which Digimon are born; they are the beginning and the end of all Digimon. It is a portmanteau of the words "Digital" and "Tamago" (卵), egg in Japanese, hence it is literally translated as "Digi-Egg".

They come in a variety of colors, shapes, and sizes and typically hatch into Baby I Digimon

entries.name: Concept: Atribute
entries.content:
Attribute (属性 Zokusei, suffixed with 種 Shu ) refers to the type of computer file a Digimon represents. In Virtual Pets such as Digimon Pendulum, Digimon Pendulum Progress, and Digimon Pendulum X, attribute is also called Type. There are six different possible attributes:

Vaccine -Va
Data - Da
Virus - Vi
Free	
Variable - Ba
Unknown

The Digimon are generally separated into three different attributes "Data", "Vaccine" and "Virus", depending on the influence that they cause in the Environment. Digimon with the same name and different attributes sometimes look different and in some cases have different attacks or types as well. There are also "Free" and "Variable" attributes that are related to the Digimon known as "Ancient Species". Digimon with the Variable attribute, which at least so far means Hybrid, change attribute to match that of their opponent. Vaccine digimon are supposed to be more powerful against Virus digimon, Virus digimon are supposed to be more powerful against Data digimon, and Data digimon are supposed to be more powerful against Vaccine digimon.

In a more general sense, they can also represent personality types, mainly the three main attributes of Vaccine, Data, and Virus:

Vaccine: They are created to prevent the destruction of important Data by Virus Digimon. They have a strong attack instinct against Virus Species, so they act combating the Virus Species and thus protecting the surrounding environment and its own territory. As a rule, Vaccine Digimon are usually good, put a high emphasis on justice and morals, and fight against evil.

Data: They are like the e-mails that are sent using computers. They do not belong to either "Vaccines" or "Virus", but they need "Vaccines" to protect themselves from "Virus". They just exist according to the already established environment and don't do much to change it. Data Digimon can be good or evil, but generally value peace above all.

Virus: They are Digimon that devour data, recognized as evil Digimon that destroy data from computers. Virus species seek to modify the surrounding environment according to their wishes. As a result, anomalies end up appearing in the system. Virus Digimon desire power, and can often become greedy, selfish, wild, or evil in pursuit of it.

Digimon of the same attribute will generally get along well with each other. However, all of the above is not set in stone and there have been heroic Virus Digimon, as well as villainous Vaccine Digimon. The Attribute system started out as a sort of "Rock, Paper, Scissors" determinator in the virtual pets. This is still, in essence, in use in most mediums (especially the Card Game), though less strongly stressed.

Vaccine is dominant over Virus. Virus is dominant over Data. Data is dominant over Vaccine. Variable is 'tied' with all other Attributes, a rather unique factor in R/P/S variants. Unknown is dominant over all other Attributes.

entries.name: Concept: Evolution Stage
entries.content:
Evolution Stage—also referred to by various other names—is a classification that, broadly speaking, denotes how powerful a Digimon is. When a Digimon undergoes evolution, it typically becomes a Digimon of a higher Evolution Stage than its previous form, so Evolution Stages are also roughly analogous to phases in the Digimon life cycle.

Each new Evolution Stage requires more and more data than the last in order to be evolved into, so evolution gets progressively more difficult as Evolution Stage increases. As a result of this, there are fewer and fewer Digimon of each subsequent Evolution Stage, and the majority of Digimon in the wild do not evolve any further than the Adult level.

Although Evolution Stages generally represent a linear progression in power, where Digimon of a given level are uniformly more powerful than those of the previous level, there are rare exceptions. For example, Lucemon: Falldown Mode is classified as Perfect, but it is significantly more powerful than many Ultimate Digimon, including the other Great Demon Lords (all of whom are Ultimate).

There are some cases where, for whatever reason, there exist variations of the same species of Digimon which have different Evolution Stages from each other despite, in some cases, being otherwise indistinguishable. For example, both Adult and Perfect Whamon exist, and although they are identical in appearance and have been verified as both being of the same species, the Perfect Whamon has nonetheless evolved to a higher Evolution Stage than its Adult brethren, whom it surpasses in both offensive ability and vitality.

Not all Digimon species have an identified Evolution Stage, and some are classified as having no Evolution Stage at all.

Evolution Stage is also the basis on which methods of attaining evolution by combining multiple Digimon together are typically, but not universally, distinguished from each other. As a general rule, if the Digimon that results from the combination of two or more Digimon is of a higher Evolution Stage than all of the constituent Digimon, it is considered Jogress Evolution. Otherwise, it is considered fusion.

Nomenclature: Evolution Stages are usually referred to by a specific name. They can also be referred to by a number, following a convention established by various trading card games (for example, the Child level is "Level III").

Other media sometimes call the concept of Evolution Stages by other terms, including:

Level (レベル Reberu; Dub: Level)
The standard term, used in the vast majority of Digimon media, including Digimon Web and the Digimon Reference Book.
Generation (世代 Sedai; Dub: Generation)
Commonly used in role-playing video games like the Digimon World and Digimon Story series, to avoid confusion with the role-playing game concept of levels which also features in those games.
Form (形態 Keitai; Dub: Form)
Used in the Digimon Card Game, as the term for the particular Characteristic field in which a Digimon's Evolution Stage is listed by name (as opposed to the numerical Level system in the game's mechanics). Also occasionally used for other keywords, such as "D-Reaper" and "Eater".

Natural Evolution Stages: The natural life cycle of a Digimon, without use of any artificial means of evolution, is comprised of six Evolution Stages.

Level 0 (Digitama) -> Level I (Baby I) -> Level II (Baby II) -> Level III (Child) -> Level IV (Adult) -> Level V (Perfect) -> Level VI (Ultimate)

entries.name: Concept: Baby I
entries.content:
Baby I (幼年期Ⅰ Yōnenki; Dub: Baby/Fresh/In-Training I), also referred to as Level I, is the first natural Evolution Stage in Digimon evolution.

**Overview : **
Baby I is the Evolution Stage that Digimon typically belong to immediately upon hatching from a Digitama. At this stage in development, their composition data has not yet stabilized, so they are very weak. They are incapable of fighting and possess very little offensive capability, but can often produce some sort of weak technique to attempt to intimidate or surprise threats, such as blowing bubbles, spitting small projectiles, creating visual distractions, or swelling in size.

The majority of Baby I Digimon belong to the Slime Type and, typically, are depicted as not having an Attribute.

It is rare for Digimon to be artificially created from the Baby stage.

Baby Digimon characteristically have friendly and highly curious personalities, although there are exceptions such as the unusually aggressive and territorial Sunamon.

Dragon-species Baby Digimon are few in number and have poor survival rates, as the majority of them are said to be either captured or killed before they grow up. In the case of Jyarimon, this may be due to its disposition to try and confront Digimon larger than itself.

Baby I Digimon evolve into Baby II Digimon, at which point their compositional data stabilizes, although they remain unable to fight. This evolution is often depicted as occurring relatively quickly, such as in the virtual pets.

entries.name: Concept: Baby II
entries.content:
Baby II (幼年期Ⅱ Yōnenki; Dub: In-Training/In-Training II), also referred to as Level II, is the second natural Evolution Stage in Digimon evolution.

Baby II is the next Evolution Stage following Baby I. At this point in development, Digimon's compositional data stabilizes. However, they remain incapable of fighting and possess poor offensive capability, but can often produce some sort of weak technique to attempt to intimidate or surprise threats, such as blowing bubbles,[3] emitting ultrasonic shouts,[4] or physically striking them.

The majority of Baby II Digimon species are small, round and limbless in shape. There are exceptions that have grown limbs, such as Tokomon (four small limb-like protrusions) and Chibimon (a body, hands, and feet), but they are extremely rare. Wings, like Poromon's, are also a rarity for Baby II Digimon.

The majority of Baby II Digimon belong to the Lesser Type and, typically, are depicted as not having an Attribute.

It is rare for Baby Digimon to take in the X-Antibody. The only extant X-Antibody Baby Digimon is Tokomon (X-Antibody), who is often preyed upon for its X-Antibodies.

Baby II Digimon evolve into Child Digimon, at which point they undergo significant progress in their cognitive development, strength, and awakening of their combat instincts, and become able to fight.

entries.name: Concept: Child
entries.content:
Child, also referred to as Level III, is the third natural Evolution Stage in Digimon evolution.

Child is the next Evolution Stage following Baby II. A Child Digimon is still in the process of growing and developing. At this point, the Digimon demonstrates progress not only in its cognitive development, but also in developing its strength and awakening its combat instincts. As such, the Child level is the threshold where Digimon typically become able to fight. Child Digimon also commonly have a mischievous streak to their personalities.

The Child level is a formative period in the lifespan of Digimon, and the course of a Child Digimon's future evolution can diverge drastically depending on its experiences and how it is raised while at this Evolution Stage. Child Digimon evolve into Adult Digimon, at which point they are considered to be fully grown Digimon.

Child Digimon are typically small in stature. There are exceptions, such as Renamon, whose tall and slender build stands out compared to other Child Digimon.

It was once commonly accepted that artificial Digimon species are incapable of evolving any further than the Child level, but this assumption was disproven by the existence of the Adult-level Eosmon.

entries.name: Species: Algomon (Baby I)
entries.content:
Argomon (Fresh) is a Mutant Digimon. It is a Fresh Digimon born from a bug in an algorithm/computational program. It has a habit of finding and converging at places where high-capacity data leaks out. They gather one by one, growing into a horde and blanketing it.

**Attacks :**
Acid Bubbles (さんのアワ San no Awa?)

**Design :**
Argomon (Fresh) resembles a green cell with an eyespot in the front, in reference to Argus Panoptes, and a pink, snail-like eye on top of its head. It has an extendable piston like that of Erythropsidinium.

entries.name: Species: Bombmon
entries.content:
Bombmon is a Slime Digimon. It is a short-tempered Digimon that easily blows its top at trivial things. As it loses its temper, its topknot steadily shortens, and when the topknot has completely retracted into its head, its anger explodes. Although it has several Special Moves, all of them have the power of a firecracker. However, because of its vivid beauty, it is often enjoyed as a party entertainment. It is a nuisance for Bombmon that it is provoked even though it is at a party.

**Attacks :**
Bomberhead: Heaps shock-waves upon the opponent.
Fireworks Revolution: Scatters particles of various colors.

**Design:**
Bombmon appears as a blue sphere with a fuse on its head, drawing particular inspiration from the cherry bomb. The sphere has eyes and a mouth.

entries.name: Species: Bommon
entries.content:
Bommon is a Slime Digimon. It has a bomb-shaped body. The fuse on its tail ignites the moment it hatches from its egg and steadily grows shorter, but because it digivolves to the next generation before the fuse disappears, nobody knows what will happen if the fuse goes out. It possesses a short-tempered personality, and it's said that when it gets in a bad mood, the progress of the fuse gets faster.

**Attack :**
Crack-Crack-Crackle (バチバチバッチン Bachibachibacchin?): Suddenly produces intense crackles from the sparks of its fuse, surprising any opponent who sees it.

entries.name: Species: Botamon
entries.content:
Botamon is a Slime Digimon of Baby I level. It was just born recently, and on the surface of its slime-shaped body, it has grown thick, black fuzz. It is unable to battle as it has just been born.

**Attacks :**
Bubble Blow (酸の泡 San no Awa, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Produces bubble-like objects from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Bubbles (泡 Awa, lit. "Bubbles"): Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

**Design :**
Botamon is a botamochi-shaped creature with black fur, yellow eyes, and small ears

entries.name: Species: Bubbmon
entries.content:
Bubbmon is a Slime Digimon. Although it looks like it is just pale green bubbles at first glance, it is a Bubble Digimon that can move freely and express a plethora of facial expressions. Because its surface has not hardened yet, its defensive power is nonexistent and it is equally unsuited for combat. From the portion that looks like a pacifier held in its mouth, it generates tiny bubbles, and proliferates them infinitely. As for that proliferation, at one point, it started being used for computer virus development, but because its life force was too weak, that was fortunately never implemented. Although its life is fleeting, it is a lovable Digimon Baby that lives earnestly.

**Attacks :**
Adhesive Bubble Blow (粘着性の泡 Nenchakusei no Awa, lit. "Adhesive Bubbles"): Escapes while the intruder's movement is restricted by the adhesive bubbles it generates from within its body.
Bubbles (泡 Awa, lit. "Bubbles"): Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

entries.name: Species: Chibickmon
entries.content:
Chibickmon is a Slime Digimon. It is a sociable, hardworking Digimon. Since they like to help their manager, before you even know what kind of work you're doing, a large number of them will appear to help you out. However, because it doesn't really understand the basic details of the work, even though it's trying to help someone, it just ends up getting in the way. Frankly speaking, because it will begin to sob if it is ignored or treated unkindly, it's a bit depressing. That's why, even if you think it really is trying to be a bother, it's important to praise it, even with a lie. To work hard and quickly join the Starmons is Chibickmon's dream.

**Attacks :**
Chinchikurinrin (チンチクリンリン lit. "Shorties")
Petit Sugar Plum

entries.name: Species: Chicomon
entries.content:
Chicomon is a Slime Digimon, and as such, it is small and young. It is a small, blue-colored, Dragon Digimon child, and although it is small and powerless, it has the potential to digivolve to every Dragon Digimon. For that reason, it is a Digimon that is considered exceedingly valuable by tamers and researchers of Dragon Digimon. It is cherished due to its personality of friendliness and overflowing curiosity, characteristic of Fresh Digimon. Just like other Fresh Digimon, it spits acidic bubbles to attack, but as usual, their power is nonexistent.

**Attack :**
Frothy Spit (酸の泡 San no Awa?, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acidic bubbles with nonexistent power to attack.

**Design :**
Chicomon is a light blue blob that has a dragon-like laid back horn similar to Chibimon.

entries.name: Species: Choromon
entries.content:
Choromon is a Machine Digimon. It is super-tiny and has red eyes that act as photosensors. The appearance of it moving around restlessly seems very cute, but because it is carrying nothing but a simple program that moves in reaction to bright lights, if its surroundings go dark, it becomes completely unable to move. The reason why is not understood, but when it is in a good mood, it discharges electricity from the tip of its tail.

**Attacks :**
Jamming Powder: Releases iron grains to cause temporary disorder in the opponent's AI, then flees while the opponent is confused.

entries.name: Species: Cocomon
entries.content:
Conomon is a Slime Digimon. Conomon and Zerimon are extremely rare Digimon which are born in pairs from a single Digi-Egg. The reason why only Zerimon and Conomon are born as twins is unclear at the present stage. Moreover, they are not restricted to always being born as twins, and either a Zerimon or Conomon may be born from a single Digi-Egg. Compared to the extremely energetic, one-horned Zerimon, the three-horned Conomon has a relatively docile personality. Like other Fresh Digimon, it spits acid bubbles to intimidate opponents.

**Attack :**
Acid Bubbles (酸の泡 San no Awa)

**Design :**
Conomon is a small brown blob with a long, frayed tail. Unlike its twin Zerimon, it has three horns.

entries.name: Species: Cotsucomon
entries.content:
Cotsucomon is an Armor Digimon. It was born wearing a leather cap. Compared to ordinary Baby I, it looks strong due to the fact it has armor, but its defensive ability is not very great because of the comparatively soft material. Its personality is hypervigilant, and it immediately buries itself in its cap.

**Attacks :**
Knock (コッツン Kottsun?, lit. "Tapping"): Pokes the opponent with the brim of its cap.

entries.name: Species: Curimon
entries.content:
Curimon is a Slime Digimon. It is a Fresh Digimon characterized by the single horn on its brow and its frill. It is so active that, before it is even born, its Digi-Egg bounces, and after hatching, it moves around vigorously. The horn on its brow and the frill on its head are still immature and soft, and although they cannot be used in battle yet, they help it to keep its balance while moving around and to defend itself even when hit.

**Attack :**
Bubbles (泡 Awa): Heroically threatens approaching enemies by producing bubbles.

**Design :**
Curimon is a small, spherical white Digimon with black eyes, a small ceratopsian-based frill with red markings on its forehead, and a red-tipped white horn on its brow.

entries.name: Species: Dodomon
entries.content:
Dodomon is a Slime Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody of Baby I level. Its whole body is covered in a tough fur named "Mithril Hair". It manifests an aggressive personality immediately after being born, and despite its fangs not yet being grown, it opens its mouth wide and completely intimidates the opponent with the manner in which it snaps at them. Because of this, there exist many Digimon which are completely deceived, but it is still a rare Digimon.

**Attacks :**
- Chīsana Tetsu Tsubu (小さな鉄粒? lit. "Little Iron Beads"): Spits small iron beads from its mouth at an approaching opponent.

entries.name: Species: Dokimon
entries.content:
Dokimon is a Slime Digimon. It is a Digimon that was born from human vital data. You can't tell from just its appearance, but when picked up, its whole body vibrates at a constant rhythm. The rhythm of these vibrations seems to reflect that of the heartbeat of the person who is holding it.

**Attacks :**
Static Shock (静電気 Seidenki?, lit. "Static Electricity"): When it is in danger, it threatens the enemy with static electricity emitted from the tip of its horn.

**Design :**
Dokimon is a White Spheroid with a green colored V form in its forehead and yellow eyes.

entries.name: Species: Fufumon
entries.content:
Fufumon is a Slime Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It has an extremely light body, so it has floated through the air since it was born, but because it floats so slowly, it is easy for opponents to target it. When its life is threatened by an assault from a larger opponent, it will thrust at them with the horn on its head to intimidate them with all its might, but because the horn is very soft, the thrust will not injure the opponent.

**Attack :**
Little Iron Spikes (小さな鉄のトゲ Chīsana Tetsu no Toge?): Spits small iron spikes from its mouth at an approaching opponent.

entries.name: Species: Fusamon
entries.content:
Fusamon is a Slime Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody of Baby I level. It has soft fur all over its body. Highly curious in nature, this Digimon loves to move around. However, it gets tired very easily, and spends most of its time asleep. When danger draws near, it lets out "Puppy Noise".

**ATTACK:**
Puppy Noise: Lets out a high-pitched warning cry.

**DESIGN:**
Fusamon is a Spherical Digimon that reminiscent of a puppy with blue fur and white face. Its nose is black and eyes (when are open) are red.

entries.name: Species: Jyarimon
entries.content:
Jyarimon is a Slime Digimon. It is an extremely scarce Digimon, whose population is small. The Fresh-levels of Dragon-species Digimon are small in absolute number, and it is said that most of them are captured or die before they grow up. You wouldn't know it to look at it, but there are tiny, closely packed fangs growing within its mouth, and it is foreseen that it will grow into a powerful Dragon-species Digimon. Although it is powerless, it has the disposition to face those with bodies larger than its own, and that becomes the reason for its low survival rate.

**Attacks :**
Nekki o Obita Awa (熱気を帯びた泡? lit. "Heated Bubbles"): Attacks with bubbles heated by the constant high temperatures within its body.
Awa (泡? lit. "Bubbles"): Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

entries.name: Species: Keemon
entries.content:
Keemon is a Slime Digimon. It is an evil-eyed Digimon which is always scowling. Though it's very young, it hates being crowded by others, and lives in hiding. It likes poking its nose out of hiding and harassing with its "Pushū".

**Attacks :**
Pushū (プシュー?): Spits a stream of water mixed with paint from its mouth.

**Design :**
Keemon has a rounded body with purple skin, two black eyes and two spike-like ears.

entries.name: Species: Ketomon
entries.content:
Ketomon is a Slime Digimon. It is a Digimon whose large eyes are its defining characteristic. These eyes have the ability to discern the nature of Digimon, allowing it to detect violent Digimon in advance and warn its allies of the danger.

**Attacks :**
Poppin' Tears (Poppin' Tear): When cornered, it discharges acidic bubbles from its eyes, rattling the enemy as it cries.
Awa (泡 lit. "Bubbles"): Fires bubbles from its eyes.

entries.name: Species: Kuramon
entries.content:
Kuramon is an Unidentified Digimon. It suddenly appeared on the Computer Network. Aggression, generated by the malice of people who abuse the Computer Network or the conflicts which are unfolding on the Network, manifested and a single Digi-Egg was created. Humanity's destructive instincts are condensed within that Digi-Egg, and as such, the mysterious Digimon that was born from it is an extremely dangerous being. It multiplies like a virus within the Computer Network, causing a slight degree of network failure.

**Attacks :**
Glare Eyes (Glare Eye): Produces a frothy substance from its gigantic eye.

Bubbles (泡 Awa?, lit. "Bubbles"): Produces bubbles from its eye to intimidate the opponent.


**Design :**
Kuramon is light blue Digimon with two small ears, a single orange eye, and five feet-like appendages.

entries.name: Species: Leafmon
entries.content:
Leafmon is a Slime Digimon. It has a breath of fresh greens (a tiny leaf) for its tail portion. It has many of the elements of a plant and the composition of its body includes chlorophyll, so it photosynthesizes to grow. It possesses a leaf-shaped tail, and the leaf protects it from intense sunlight or when it is raining. Due to its pure nature, it doesn't distrust others even if they are frightening. However, it is just a little bit shy. As it was just born, it is unable to battle, but its innocent spirit, overflowing with vitality, can make the surrounding people remember pure feelings that were forgotten, wrapping them in a calm air. However, if one tries to mess with it too much, it will spit acidic bubbles to intimidate them.


**Attack :**
Acid Bubbles (酸性の泡 Sansei no Awa?, lit. "Acidic Bubbles"): Spits acidic bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

**Design :**
Leafmon is small and green, and has a long tail resembling a leaf. It has two small ears on its round head, small black eyes and round pink cheeks under them, and carries a pink pacifier in its mouth.

entries.name: Species: Mokumon
entries.content:
Mokumon is a Smoke Digimon. It is a Digimon Baby which envelops its body with a smoke-like vapor. It is a unique Digimon whose DigiCore is bare, so it seems it covers its DigiCore with Smoke in order to protect it, and has an unusual way of life. Because the Smoke was generated when its DigiCore was burned, it seems it is harmful neither to Mokumon itself nor to others. Also, because it is still in the middle of digivolving, when it encounters an opponent, it immediately flees. Then, it scatters the Smoke issuing from its body all around, and seizes the opportunity to escape when the opponent loses sight of it. As stated earlier, because it isn't particularly harmful, if you happen to see one, it would be best to be quiet.

**Attack :**
Smoky Blow (Smoke): Scatters the smoke issuing from its body all around, then seizes the opportunity to escape when the opponent loses sight of it.

entries.name: Species: Nyokimon
entries.content:
Nyokimon is a Seed Digimon. Its body surface is covered in transparent tissue, and it can be confirmed that within the transparent skin is its real body, which seems to be a variant of Botamon. It is thought that it is perhaps a species of Botamon whose appearance transformed into this herbaceous body. For that reason, it is not only a Plant-species Digimon, but it also has the potential to digivolve to Dragon-species Digimon and the like. Its personality is extremely gentle, so it has a timid face, and its offensive ability is nonexistent.

**Attacks :**
Seed Cracker: Flings popping seeds, then quickly flees while the opponent is surprised.

entries.name: Species: Pafumon
entries.content:
Pafumon is a Spirit Digimon. It possesses a translucent body, and since its body is as light as down, it is constantly drifting through the air. It has the habit of moving upon the winds, and it is said that, if the wind's condition is suitable, it will migrate very far. It dislikes fights and has a gentle personality.

**Attack :**
Puff Balloon: Surprises the opponent by opening its mouth wide, sucking in air, and swelling its body up to three times its usual size, then seizes the opportunity to expel the air and escape.

entries.name: Species: Paomon
entries.content:
Paomon is a Slime Digimon. Unlike other Digimon that developed naturally, it is an artificial Digimon that was created through human effort to be used for appreciation and rearing. Although there is no shortage of Digimon at the Rookie stage whose configuration program is remodeled through human effort, Digimon artificially created from the Fresh stage are rare. According to one theory, it was developed jointly by research groups in Shanghai, Taiwan, and Okinawa, but its birthplace is not certain.

**Attacks :**
San no Awa (酸の泡 lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits resilient, acidic bubbles to intimidate the opponent.
Tsumo (Tummo): Releases a high-frequency wave that is an effective charm against evil.

**Design :**
Paomon is based on a slime-like dog with red ears on its head and a red spheroid tail on its back.

entries.name: Species: Petitmon
entries.content:
Petitmon is a Slime Digimon. It possesses large horns and tiny wings. As its body is extremely light, it lives constantly floating through the air, and maintains its posture in the air by blowing air from its wings and mouth. Although it usually has a cheerful personality, if the three scales on its belly are touched, it goes into an extremely bad mood. It's not easy to catch because it uses its "Atsui Toiki" when bodily harm draws near.

**Attack :**
Atsui Toiki (熱い吐息? lit. "Hot Sigh"): Spits its hot breath to surprise the opponent, while simultaneously using it as propulsive force to quickly flee.

**Design :**
Petitmon is based on a slime-like dragon with horns on its head, a pair of wings that act as arms, and a foot.

entries.name: Species: Pipimon
entries.content:
Pipimon is a Slime Digimon. It is born from the fruit of large trees. It is said to appear to humans who have regained their lost hope.

**Attack :**
San no Awa (酸の泡? lit. "Acid Bubbles")

**Design :**
Pipimon is a round green fruit with black eyes and pink round cheeks under them, a mouth, and two feet under its head.

entries.name: Species: Pitchmon
entries.content:
Pitchmon is a Slime Digimon. As a microorganism-like Digimon which was discovered in the "Net Ocean", it has the smallest size among a great number of Digimon. Since it seems to be living with nothing but emotions, its actions change very hectically. Due to its curiosity being extremely vigorous, it greatly wishes to communicate with the outside world, but as of yet, no means to do so have been found. However, it is a Digimon Baby that is loved by everyone, due to its big, bright red eyes which are charming enough to shake the opponent's feelings. It spits out soap-like bubbles from its mouth and blinds the opponent's eyes, then flees.

**Attack :**
Bubble Blow (シャボンの泡 Sabão no Awa?, lit. "Soap Bubbles"): Spits out soap-like bubbles from its mouth and blinds the opponent's eyes, then flees.

**Design :**
Pitchmon is based on amphipod zooplankton.

entries.name: Species: Popomon
entries.content:
Popomon is a Slime Digimon. It looks like a species of plant. It skillfully uses its tail, which looks like a leaf, and it moves by jumping little by little. Because it has a very timid personality, it will immediately flee if any strangers approach, but it is said that once it gives its trust to someone, it will be attached to them for life.

**Attacks :**
Hair Mist: Scatters the hairs of its coat while escaping the opponent to create a distraction.

entries.name: Species: Poyomon
entries.content:
Poyomon is a Slime Digimon. With a translucent body, it is a Digimon Baby that drifts through the "Net Ocean" like a jellyfish. As it has the most primitive structure among the Digimon discovered to date, it has been showered in attention as the "Missing Link", the key to solving the mystery of the origin of Digimon, by the scholars and enthusiasts studying the roots of Digimon.

**Attacks :**
Super Bubble Blow (強力な酸の泡 Kyouryoku San no Awa?, lit. "Powerful Acid Bubbles"): Spits powerfully acidic bubbles from its mouth to defend itself from intruders.

Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa?, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Bubbles (泡 Awa?, lit. "Bubbles"): Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

entries.name: Species: Punimon
entries.content:
Punimon is a Slime Digimon of Baby I level. It is a new kind of newborn Digimon. Its gelatinous red body is squishy, and there are three feeler-like things growing on its head. It is unable to battle, but it can produce resilient, acidic bubbles to intimidate its opponents.

**Attacks :**
* Bubble Blow (酸の泡 San no Awa, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Produces resilient, acidic bubbles to intimidate the opponent.

* Bubbles (泡 Awa, lit. "Bubbles"): Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

**Design :**
Punimon is red slime Digimon that has three protrusions on the top of its head, and its eyes are big and prominent with horizontally aligned symmetrical triangular markings around its eyes.

entries.name: Species: Pupumon
entries.content:
Pupumon is a Slime Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It has grown a body as light as a bubble, as well as very thin wings and somewhat largish eyes which are very sensitive to movement. If something moves, Pupumon will notice it and immediately spring away, but this doesn't mean it's a coward, as, if the object continues to be unkind and approaches, Pupumon will counterattack.

**Attacks :**
Doku no Awa (毒のアワ? lit. "Poison Bubbles"): Spits poisonous bubbles from its mouth at the opponent.

**Design :**
Pupumon is a blob with very thin wings that seem like ears.

entries.name: Species: Pururumon
entries.content:
Pururumon is a Slime Digimon. With a chubby body similar to silicon, it jiggles flabbily when it crawls forward. Both of its small fins are unexpectedly handy, but to be absolutely precise, it is not yet able to fly. As it loves the smell of the sun, on days with good weather, it lies sprawled on the lawn and smells the scent of grass with a sniff, immersing it in a good mood.

**Attacks :**
San no Awa (酸の泡? lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Foams out acidic bubbles and covers the opponent in them, then seizes the opportunity to flee.

entries.name: Species: Pusumon
entries.content:
Pusumon is a Slime Digimon. It is a Digimon whose entire body is covered in soft, cotton-like fur; only the yellow hairs sticking out of its forehead are fairly hard. It grows restless without its pacifier, and will cry loudly and incessantly if its pacifier is lost. It is able to expand its body by taking in a deep breath.

**Attacks :**
Pacifier (おしゃぶり Oshaburi?): Takes in a deep breath and shoots the inhaled air out together with its pacifier in order to intimidate the opponent.

entries.name: Species: Puttimon
entries.content:
Puttimon is a Mini Angel Digimon. It is a sacred Digimon Baby who is the template for all Angel-type Digimon. On the other hand, it has poor self-judgment between good and evil, and can be quite adorably mischievous. If anything, it's popular for bringing about things like euphoria and good fortune. Though as a newborn, it's rare for it to do so, it can fly skillfully about the sky with the two wings growing from its back.

**Attacks :**
Angel Dust: Calls forth a mysterious powder while flying about that places the opponent in a happy mood.
Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

**Design :**
The horn-like appendage on the top of its head and the swirl at the base of the appendage make its face resemble that of Chestnut Angel from Tamagotchi. BT1-006 depicts Puttimon with two additional wings.

entries.name: Species: Puwamon
entries.content:
Puwamon is a Bird Digimon. It is covered in soft down. Its eyesight is extremely great, and because it is able to survey a vast range, it can react instantly to surrounding movements. Its personality is intensely curious, and it began gaining popularity because it lacks shyness and easily makes attachments. However, it extremely dislikes when its tail is touched, and so if its tail is touched carelessly, caution is necessary because it will shower you in blinding down.

**Attacks :**
Fuwā Feather (フワーフェザー? lit. "Fluffy Feather"): Showers the opponent in blinding down.

entries.name: Species: Puyomon
entries.content:
Puyomon is a Slime Digimon. It is a soft and sticky Digimon that is found in the "Net Ocean." Its singular lens lacks emotional expression so you can't really tell what it's thinking, and it floats in the sky and sea and tries to stick to objects and other Digimon with its tentacles.

**Attacks :**
Crackling Gas (パチパチガス Pachipachi Gas) When it sticks to things, it emits a tingling static electricity which is not actually an attack, but seems to be a form of communication unique to Puyomon. When multiple Puyomon stick to each other, their Pachi Pachi Gas becomes more powerful, making it difficult to approach the surrounding area.

entries.name: Species: Pyonmon
entries.content:
Pyonmon is a Slime Digimon. It is a Fresh Digimon covered in tufty body hair that has a single large ear. It was shy the moment it was born, so if someone stares at it, it will instantly lower its head. However, it is also friendly, and can be seen rubbing its body against Digimon that it is interested in, actively engaging in skin-to-skin contact. It hates opponents that mess with it. Similarly, it hates things which make loud noises that ring in its ear, so it lowers its ear and leaves.

**Attack :**
Earwhip (イヤンタ Earnta?, lit. "Ear-slap"): Slaps the opponent with its large ear. It has the power to blow even Rookie Digimon away.

entries.name: Species: Relemon
entries.content:
Relemon is a Slime Digimon of Baby I level. It is a mysterious Digimon that is said to only be born on moonlit nights. It is said that Relemon born specifically on the night of the full moon receive its magical power, and as they grow, are able to use greater and more wondrous abilities than other Digimon. Because it is nocturnal, it seldom appears before people and has a shy personality. It is not able to attack, but it can transform into anything to defend itself, if it is close to the size of its body. However, it can still be found because it can never conceal its tail.

**Attack :**
Henshin (変身? lit. "Transformation"): Transforms into anything of a similar size, though it can't conceal its tail.

**Design :**
Relemon is a spherical Digimon with two eyes and a mouth, yellow fur, and a tail with white fur at the tip. Its inability to hide its tail is a reference to the Kitsune's similar limits.

entries.name: Species: Sakumon
entries.content:
Sakumon is a Weapon Digimon. It is a tiny Digimon which has a single blade coming out of its head. Its whole body is golden, and the blade on its head shines very brightly. Its personality is mischievous and it is constantly moving as long as it's awake, but due to the weight of its head, it is badly balanced, so surrounding Digimon can sometimes be seen running about trying to escape because it is waving the blade as it rolls around.

**Attack :**
Sakkuri (サックリ lit. "Crispy")

**Design :**
Sakumon is a golden oval creature with brown eyes, a mouth, and a golden sword-like horn.

entries.name: Species: Sunamon
entries.content:
Sunamon is a Slime Digimon. Its body is made of sand. It has an aggressive personality despite being a Fresh, and is strongly territorial. It has an amorphous body which can disperse like sand or conversely harden like clay, but its pacifier alone is unable to change shape in any way. When opponents approach it throws a lot of sand to intimidate them.[2]

**Attacks :**
Sand Toss (砂かけ Sunakake?): Throws a lot of sand to intimidate approaching opponents.

entries.name: Species: Tsubumon
entries.content:
Tsubumon is a Slime Digimon. It has an appearance like a seed, although it is not a Plant-species Digimon. It cannot fly, but it is able to move over land, water, or anywhere, while hopping and bouncing, and it is said that there is no place where Tsubumon cannot move through. However, because of its small body, it is sent flying on days with a strong wind, and as a result of that, it is often mistaken for a Plant-species.
 
**Attacks :**
San no Awa (酸の泡? lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Drives off the opponent with acidic bubbles.

entries.name: Species: Yolkmon
entries.content:
Yolkmon is a Slime Digimon. It is still wearing the shell from its Digi-Egg on its head. It is laid-back in nature and makes a life for itself slipping into the nests of other Digimon. As the Digi-Egg shell acts as camouflage, Yolkmon is hardly ever spotted before it Digivolves. In the unlikely event that Yolkmon is discovered by a threat, it can use "Bubbles".

**Attacks :**
Bubbles (泡 Awa?): Produces bubbles from its body to intimidate other Digimon.

**Design :**
Yolkmon resembles a Yolk, with the remains of its Digi-Egg acting as the cracked Egg.

entries.name: Species: YukimiBotamon
entries.content:
YukimiBotamon is a Slime Digimon. It is a Baby Digimon whose whole body is covered in fluffy, white hair. It is considered a species of Botamon, and was named "YukimiBotamon" after its white body, but the details are not clearly known. It is weak to heat, and tends to prefer cold places, so its body feels cold to the touch. When YukimiBotamon exhales, the moisture in the air freezes, and falls while brilliantly glittering.

**Attack :**
Diamond Dust: Breathes out freezing cold air.

entries.name: Species: Yuramon
entries.content:
Yuramon is a Seed Digimon. Its whole body is covered in a substance with the appearance of long, soft hair. When it hatches from its Digi-Egg, it seeks an environment suitable for its growth, and drifts lightly through the air, like a dandelion seed. If it finds a place where there will be no intruders and where the environment is good, it will settle to the ground and begin preparations for Digivolution. Its offensive ability is practically nil.

**Attacks :**
Bubble Blow[5] (粘着性の泡 Nenchakusei no Awa?, lit. "Adhesive Bubbles"): Spits out adhesive bubbles to hinder the opponent's movement, then seizes the opportunity to escape.

entries.name: Species: Zerimon
entries.content:
Zerimon is a Slime Digimon. Zerimon and Conomon are extremely rare Digimon, which are born in pairs from a single Digi-Egg. Why only Zerimon and Conomon are born as twins is not clearly known at the present stage. What is more, they are not restricted to always being born as twins, and either a Zerimon or Conomon may be born from a single Digi-Egg. Compared to the extremely energetic, one-horned Zerimon, the three-horned Conomon has a relatively docile personality. Also, unlike other Slime Digimon, Zerimon is perfectly firm other than just the horn on its head. Like other Fresh Digimon, it spits acid bubbles to intimidate opponents.

**Attacks :**
Acid Bubbles (酸の泡 San no Awa?): Spits acid bubbles to intimidate the opponent.

**Design :**
Zerimon is a small green blob with a long, frayed tail. Unlike its twin Conomon, it has one horn. In the Wonderswan Color games, its body is white and its tail is green.

entries.name: Species: Zurumon
entries.content:
Zurumon is a Slime Digimon. It was produced from the fusion of an extra-malignant computer virus and a computer hacker's evil desires, an evolutionary origin which differs from other Digimon of the special Slime type. It operates its supple body skillfully in order to crawl across the ground. The substance that composes its body is powerfully toxic, and because it spews venom-tinged bubbles from its mouth, even larger Digimon won't approach.

**Attack :**
Poison Bubbles (毒の泡 Doku no Awa): Spews venom-tinged bubbles.

**Design :**
Zurumon is a yellow slime Digimon with red eyes and a mouth.

entries.name: Species: Algomon (Baby II) - 1
entries.content:
Algomon (Baby II) is a Mutant Digimon. It is the form that a newborn Algomon grows into. It is attached to places where large volumes of data flow and consumes that data through the mouth on its underside. It is a creepy one-eyed Digimon with a green body and tentacles that stretch out like arms. Since it's In-Training, it's still very weak, but it's up to some sort of evil and bringing a bad influence to the Real World...!

**Attacks :**
Acid Bubbles (酸のアワ San no Awa) When an enemy draws near, it spits out its "Acid Bubbles" from its giant eye-like pattern.

**Design :**
Algomon (Baby II) resembles a green flapjack octopus (Opisthoteuthis californiana) with an eyespot in the front, in reference to Argus Panoptes, and a pair of eyes resembling those of a snail infected with Leucochloridium paradoxum on top of its head. It has nine short tendrils tipped with drills and a pair of purple arms. It has a disk-like mouth with six triangular plates on its underside.

**Prior Form:**
* Algomon (Baby I)

entries.name: Species: Arkadimon (Baby) - 2
entries.content:
Arkadimon (Baby) is a Digimon. It is a Digimon artificially created from the data of various Digimon. One result of an experiment to make the ultimate Digimon, it boasts amazing physical abilities despite being In-Training level. Arkadimon demonstrates predatory behavior. By directly absorbing the data of others, Arkadimon achieves growth at an astounding rate.

**Attacks :**
Data Drain (データドレイン Dēta Dorein): Stabs opponents with its sharp feet to absorb their data.

**Design :**
Arkadimon (Baby) resembles a mix of a spider and a leech. It has a long arm ending in a single claw hidden in an opening lined with teeth in its back

entries.name: Species: Babydmon - 3
entries.content:
Babydmon is a Baby Dragon Digimon. Babydmon's body bears a striking resemblance to a dragon. While this Digimon was only discovered recently, it has been made clear through data analysis that it contains a program code specific to ancient Digimon, and that it is related to the long-lost, ancient species of Digimon. Babydmon is ferocious despite its small size, and anyone who makes careless movements in front of it will get blown at with the high temperature gas formed within its body.

**Attacks :**
Hot Steam (Hot Gas): Fires a blow of hot gas produced in its body. The gas is not just hot but also spicy.

entries.name: Species: Bibimon - 4
entries.content:
Bibimon is a Lesser Digimon. It is a Digimon that digivolved from Dokimon. It lacks composure, and is always moving around mischievously. However, because it is not used to dealing with four limbs yet, it very often loses its balance in the middle of running and tumbles over. When it comes to battle, it uses its "Minimal Flash" to fight bravely against the enemy, despite being a Baby II.

**Attacks :**
Minimal Flash: A static electricity-laced tackle.

entries.name: Species: Bosamon - 5
entries.content:
Bosamon is a Lesser Digimon. It is a Digimon that evolved from Pyonmon. Its bangs have grown out, hiding its eyes, so it can now move around without worrying about others looking at it. Its shy personality has changed into one that is calm. It now has two long ears and its sense of hearing has developed. It is able to perceive sound in three dimensions, and listening to conversations between fellow Digimon from a distance has become its hobby. It has a lot of information about things that it has not experienced first-hand thanks to that. It hates fighting, and quickly detects the enemy approaching, and leaves the area. Even if the escape is blocked, it will hide itself while startling the opponent with its combo attack "Eardrum (ミッコミ Mikkomi, lit. "Ear-strike")".

**Attacks :**
Eardrum (ミッコミ Mikkomi, lit. "Ear-strike"): Slaps the opponent with its ears.

entries.name: Species: Bowmon - 6
entries.content:
Bowmon is a Lesser Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. It has soft fur all over its body. It is curious about everything it sees, and has a habit of sniffing whatever has captured its interest. Although a very active Digimon, it often falls over when running due to its short legs. It is unable to ascend or descend a difference in elevation greater than the length of its legs, and has to roll itself around to move on surfaces with frequent variation in height. When a hostile presence approaches, it will threaten them with "Puppy Spark".

**Attacks :**
Puppy Spark: A pyrotechnic bark.

**Design :**
Bowmon is a quadrupedal puppy-like wolf Digimon, it has blue fur in mostly body with white on snout and end of tail. Its nose is black and its eyes are red.

entries.name: Species:  Budmon - 7
entries.content:
Budmon is a Plant Digimon. Blended from the data of various poisonous plants, it has the form of a flower bud. Usually, it drifts through the air carried by its leaf, and doesn't attack as long as nothing happens.

**Attacks :**
* Poisonous Thorns (ドクトゲトゲ Dokutogetoge, lit. "Poison Thorns"): Attacks with thorns that are painful if touched. If it gets angry, it can also fire them off.
* Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

**Design :**
* Budmon resembles a green ball with eyes and mouth, multiple pink spikes, and a leaf for a tail. It has a fang on the left side of its mouth.

entries.name: Species:  Caprimon - 8
entries.content:
Caprimon is a Lesser Digimon. It is a tiny Digimon wearing a metallic helmet. Within the two horns attached to its helmet, it has antennae that are able to receive any radio wave or sound. Caprimon is in possession of bat-like traits, as it has weak eyesight, and produces ultrasonic waves from its mouth, recognizing the objects ahead of it from the rebounding sound wave. For that reason, Caprimon is able to act irrespective of day or night. Among In-Baby II Digimon, it has superior durability.

**Attacks :**
* Howling Blow (Howling Hertz): Generates a resonance between its two horns, creating a sound wave that will paralyze even a large Digimon.
* Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa?, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

entries.name: Species:  Chapmon - 9
entries.content:
Chapmon is a Lesser Digimon. It only lives in clear, beautiful waters, so it can only be seen in limited areas within the Digital World. It spends most of the day on the water's surface, and when it sleeps, it sleeps with only its face poking out of the surface. It has the sensitivity to detect the approach of opponents just from tiny movements of the water's surface, and will escape to a safe spot before it is found.

**Attacks :**
* Foam Shower: Spits bubbles from its mouth to confuse the opponent, then flees.

entries.name: Species:  Chibimon - 10
entries.content:
Chibimon is a Baby Dragon Digimon. It evolved from Chicomon. Unusually for a Baby II Digimon, it possesses a body, hands, and feet, and so is able to grip objects with both of its small hands, and move while hopping about with both feet. As it is very voracious, it especially likes sweet foods. Also, as it is very fond of sleeping, if you take your eyes off of it, it will instantly fall asleep.

**Attacks :**
* Pop Attack (Hop Attack): Rams into the opponent while hopping about.

**Design :**
Chibimon is a tiny, blue small Dragon Digimon with expressive red eyes. Unlike its pre-evolution Chicomon, Chibimon has a very contrast of its colors, being blue on mostly body as while white is the face and belly, indicating is evolving into V-Mon.

entries.name: Species:  Chicchimon - 11
entries.content:
Chicchimon is a Digimon. It looks like a chick, and it is still physically weak and not suitable for an actual fight.

**Attacks :**
* Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

**Design :**
* Chicchimon is a yellow oval creature that resembles a chick's head. It has black eyes, a yellow beak, and stubby wing-like appendages on the sides of its body. It also has thick red eyebrows, and a long red ponytail.

entries.name: Species:  Chocomon - 12
entries.content:
Chocomon is a Lesser Digimon. It grew up from Cocomon. The personalities of the robust-natured Gummymon and the docile Chocomon are opposites, but they get along very well, and always act in unison. It is an existence of unified mind and flesh, such that if you temporarily separate the two, it will weaken due to too much loneliness.

**Attacks :**
* Double Bubble (Double Bobble): Spits out a lot of adhesive bubbles.
* Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa?, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

**Design :**
* Kokomon is a small brown blob whose primary feature is its head, which rests above its slug-like foot and has three horns. Like its twin Gummymon, it has floppy ears.

entries.name: Species:  Culumon - 13
entries.content:
Culumon is an Animal Digimon. It is a small Digimon shrouded in mystery that is unable to evolve or attack, unlike other Digimon. As it is friendly and loves to play, it will appear from somewhere whenever there is fun to be had. It has a habit of adding "Culu" to the end of its sentences. Rumor has it that it possesses the ability to help other Digimon to evolve. This is the "digi-entelecheia" (the power of digivolution) given Digimon form.

**Attacks :**
* Shining Digivolution (Shining Evolution): Releases the light of Digivolution to allow Digimon to digivolve to the Mega level.
* GigaPower
* Kurumon Prayer (クルモンの祈り Culumon no Inori, lit. "Culumon Prayer"): Restore status and raise all resistance with prayer.

**Design :**
* Culumon is a small, cute white creature with large eyes and comparatively small limbs. Its ears, usually short, can extend and it can even use them to fly. Its forehead bears the Zero Unit, which can manifest as the gem-like "Crystal Matrix".

entries.name: Species:  Cupimon - 14
entries.content:
Cupimon is a Mini Angel Digimon. It evolved from Puttimon. Unlike its time as Puttimon, it likes good deeds, and loves making everyone happy. Particularly, it is called the "Angel of Charity", and its specialty is bringing about feelings of "Love" in every person. It is always flying about in the air of the Digital World, sprinkling love on everyone while making them feel happy. It is said that if even a large Digimon with a mass of fighting spirit comes across Cupimon, it will cease battling.

**Attacks :**
* Angel Ring: Generates a ring of light from the protuberance on its calvaria and throws it at the opponent.

**Design :**
* Cupimon is a bipedal creature covered in white fur. It has yellow eyes, fangs, stubby arms with three red claws each, stubby legs, three toes on each foot, and yellow wings. Its general body shape, the horn-like appendage on the top of its head and the swirl at the base of the appendage make Cupimon resemble Chestnut Angel from Tamagotchi.

entries.name: Species:  Dorimon - 15
entries.content:
Dorimon is a Lesser Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It can run very quickly if it is going straight. It is often running wild because it hates to be domesticated, and it is dangerous because it will recklessly charge and perform a ramming attack if approached. Its ears have grown sharp and hard, and because they also act as horns, there is some small damage from its ramming attacks. However, it can't turn when going at speed.

**Attacks :**
* Metal Drop: Spits an iron bead from mouth while charging at the opponent.
* Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa?, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

entries.name: Species:  Fluffymon - 16
entries.content:
Fluffymon is a Mini Bird Digimon. It goes about its activities while hiding within the luxuriant leaves of the forest trees. Its wings are undeveloped so it cannot yet fly, but it is agile enough to scamper up even vertical tree trunks. When Fluffymon deems that the threat has been sufficiently intimidated, it flees as fast as it possibly can.

**Attacks :**
* Birdy Head: Utilizes its speed to attack with a headbutt.

**Prior Form :**
* Yolkmon

entries.name: Species:  Frimon - 17
entries.content:
Frimon is a Lesser Digimon. It possesses a frill on its neck. It is able to change the hardness of the fur on its frill, and by covering its body with the frill when danger approaches, it can be used as an "Armor" to protect its body. As its curiosity is extremely vigorous, it has a habit of responding to anything that moves, but because it also responds to its own tail, it chases after it, and is often observed spinning in place.

**Attacks :**
* Shippo Binta (シッポビンタ? lit. "Tail Whip"): Increases the centrifugal force in its long tail. This is so powerful that a clean hit will occassionally knock out even a Rookie Digimon.

entries.name: Species:  Gigimon - 18
entries.content:
Gigimon is a Lesser Digimon. It is a four-legged Digimon that grew from Jyarimon. Its physical features resemble those of Tokomon, and there are powerful fangs growing within its mouth. However, unlike Tokomon, who digivolves into the Mammal-species, Gigimon, who digivolves into the Dragon-species, has a rough personality, and is ferocious despite its small size. There are more than a few even larger Digimon that were deceived by its appearance and suffered a counterattack. The temperature of its bites are hot like with Jyarimon.

**Attacks :**
* Hot Bite: Snaps at the opponent, burning the things it bites.
* Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa?, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

entries.name: Species:  Goromon - 19
entries.content:
Goromon is a Rock Digimon. It is an In-Training Digimon that grows by eating rocks. Because its digestive system is not fully developed yet, it stores an amount of ore in its body unimaginable given its small size, and gradually converts it into nourishment. The site in which its eye is located also serves as its mouth, and it seems to turn completely blind while eating.

**Attacks :**
* Rock Breath: Spits out rocks from its large mouth.

entries.name: Species:  Gummymon - 20
entries.content:
Gummymon is a Lesser Digimon. It grew up from Zerimon. As it inherited an exceedingly energetic personality from Zerimon, it is both cheerful and lively. Although it is growing, it's squishy because its body tissue is as unstable as usual, but just like Zerimon, its horn portion has hardened, and it intimidates the opponent with headbutts. Its greatest change from Zerimon is that it has a body and ear-like objects coming out of its head.

**Attacks :**
* Double Bubble (Double Bobble): Spews out a lot of adhesive bubbles.
* Frothy Spit (さんのアワ San no Awa, lit. "Acid Bubbles"): Spits acid foam at an enemy.

**Design :**
* Gummymon is a small green blob whose primary feature is its head, which rests above its slug-like foot and has one horn. Like its twin Kokomon, it has floppy ears.

entries.name: Species:  Gurimon - 21
entries.content:
Gurimon is a Lesser Digimon. It is an In-Training Digimon that grew up from Curimon and now has two horns on its brow. It bounces around energetically, and when it finds large, hard rocks, it strikes them with its horn-charging signature move "Prickle Attack (チクチクアタック Chikuchiku Attack?, lit. "Prickly Attack")". It enjoys coming across whole rocks, and runs around bursting with energy to become even stronger. Its frill has grown harder, and it seems that in addition to protecting its soft body, it also has the effect of making it look bigger.

**Attacks :**
* Prickle Attack (チクチクアタック Chikuchiku Attack, lit. "Prickly Attack"): Horn-charges.

**Design :**
* Gurimon is a small, spherical white Digimon with yellow eyes, a ceratopsian-based frill with red markings, a small black horn on its nose, and two red-tipped white horns on its brow.

entries.name: Guilmon
entries.content:
Guilmon is a Reptile Digimon. Guilmon is a bipedal small size dinosaur-like creature with red scales and yellow eyes. It has three claws on each hand and two claws on the front of each foot, and one claw on the back of each foot. It also has two wing-like appendages on its head. It also has white scales on its belly, and a Digital Hazard on it. It also has black horizontal lines on its arms, legs, neck, back, and tail, two black marks under its eyes, and a black triangle mark on each shoulder.

Guilmon in battle relays on brute force, powerful tail, sharp claws and teeth and on its fire attacks. Guilmon typical abilities and moves are "Rock Breaker", "Pyro Sphere", "Gill Shoot", "Wild Scratch" and "Sharp Claw"

In "Digital World 3.3" Many Guilmons are overall aggressive despite their friendly looks but they usually keep their aggressive behavior in cheek by scratching or biting useless junk or simply finding some hobbies to occupy their minds.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"
