entries.name: ❤︎ - Vixen Quiz Rules - ❤︎
entries.content: Rules of game are to test knowledge about Digimon which are registered in the Digidex. Usually Question got four answers to pick from which only one is correct. But on more advanced questions for bonus round the contestant of the quiz needs to give own response.

entries.name: Gatomon
entries.content:
Gatomon is a Holy Beast Digimon which looks like a small cat wearing large Yellow and Red striped gloves with black claws sticking out of them. Ears are large with tufts of purple hair on the tips reminiscent of a caracal. Tail has purple stripes with a tuft on the end. Pink Paw Pads. Usually Ice Blue eyes. White Fur covers its entire body. Gatomons got their Dark Variant version which is of a "Virus Type" and got black fur.

Gatomon most common abilities and moves are "Neko Punch", "Tail Whip" and "Flurry of Fury". Some Gatomons can also use "Cat's Eye Hypnotism" but its a move many of them cant learn or simply forget they can use it. Overall Gatomon relay on their speed, small size body and sharp fangs, claws and long tails and trickery if needed during battles.

Digimon Level of a Gatomon is "Champion".
Gatomon is a "Vaccine Type" Digimon.

Gatomons can Digivolve both normally into next level forms and they can Digivolve with Digiegg method into many forms depending on the Digiegg crest.

In "Digital World 3.3" Both Black-Gatomons and Gatomons can be encountered anywhere in the world and its a custom for many of them to run Hotels, INNs, Shops or Small Businesses.

Gatomons are not too aggressive but by nature they are a bit mischievous and sassy

entries.name: Beastmon
entries.content:
Beastmon also known as Bestemon is a Beastkin Digimon. Bastemons are very tall and resembles a humanoid nekomata dressed in a form of Egyptian badlah or a belly dancer for some. Bastemon has light brown skin with fur like a bengal cat, purple eyes, and long, braided red hair collected in a hair ornament tipped with a large diamond. Its arms are long and gangly, and both its arm and leg paws have lengthy, magenta claws. It wears a lavender yashmak, red crescent-shaped pasties, leopard-print şalvar, and a henna mehndi on its bare midriff. Bastemon wears a large assortment of jewelry, including a simple gold diadem with a crimson jewel, gold disc earrings, a carnelian necklace, a gold hinged bracelet with an azure jewel around its upper arm, many gold bangles around its forearms, ankles, and tails, many gold and crimson-jeweled signet rings on each finger and toe, gold bands with crimson jewels around its forefeet, ornate gold finger stalls, gold girdles, and a gold Cleopatra belt. Beastmon also has two long cat tails which are very flexible and strong.

Beastmon thanks to big size and raw power is dangerous even without their elegant dancing moves skills but Beastmon will almost always use its graceful dance skills in battle and will also relay on its high speed, reflexes, long sharp claws and trickery usually paired with two tails. Beastmon abilities and moves are "Witch Trap", "Mind Fogger" and a "Vampire Jewel". Beastmon can drain energy of its charmed victims and even use them as thralls if needed. To do so Beastmon needs to be close to their victim to suck energy or even blood and target needs to be in weaken or charmed state.

In "Digital World 3.3" Beastmons are very rare as it takes not only strength but also natural grace and skill and personality for a Digimon to be able to even Digivolve into a Beastmon.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Ultimate"

entries.name: Viximon
entries.content:
Viximon is a small yellow round ball with four legs, a pair of sharp pointy fox ears and a fluffy white-tipped tail. Cute round blue eyes. They are very small and weak Digimon but quite fast. Viximons are quick learners and Digivolve with time into Renamons. They are hard to spot as by default they prefer to stay out of sight and observe from distance and learn.

Viximon don't have any real fighting skills beside charge which is not really that strong due to their small size and weight so they relay on their allies for protection or simply hide or avoid conflict at all cost.

Digimon Type: "None" but changes later into "Data" Type when it Digivolves.
Digimon Level: "In-Training"

entries.name: Nyaromon
entries.content:
Nyaromon is a very small yellow colored fur ball Digimon with cat tail and cat ears. It got big mouth and big eyes which take almost half of its body. Nyaromon got short but nice in touch yellow fur, cute cat ears and a tail with purple stripes. Its eyes are light red cat eyes.

Nyaromon are weak and avoid fighting but if needed they can use their tail to slap opponent or shoot bubbles out of their mouth or simply use a headbutt.

Digimon Type: "None"
Digimon Level: "In-Training"

entries.name: Gigimon
entries.content:
Gigimon is a small round red colored Digimon with yellow eyes and big mouth. It got four tiny legs, wing shaped like ears, short and thick tail with black tip. Small but sharp teeth. Black triangle markings under eyes. Gigimons digivolve into Guilmons eventually. While Gigimon may be a small Digimon they can still put a fight for small opponents with their teeth and fire breathing ability which while still very weak on current level may still be painful for some opponents.

"Hot Bite" is main and probably strongest attack of Gigimon where they lock enemy in a bite which is followed by burning attack on the locked target.

Digimon Type: "None" but becomes a "Virus" type after Digivolving into Guilmon
Digimon Level: "In-Training"

entries.name: Renamon
entries.content:
Renamon is a bipedal fox-like Digimon. Most of its body is covered in yellow fur, save for the tips of its tail and ears, underbelly, hands and legs from the knees down, and the purple futatsudomoe symbols on its thighs. It also has wing-like tufts of yellow fur on its shoulders and a large, mane-like tuft of white fur on its chest. Its wears sleeves that cover its forearms with yin-yang symbols on the back of the hands. It has three clawed fingers on its hands and three clawed toes on its feet. It has black eyes with indigo pupils.

Renamon are known for their speed, high intelligence and fascination and adaptability with martial arts. Renamon most famous attack is "Diamond Storm" which is a long range attack where it Throws sharpened leaves at the opponent or diamond shaped energy pieces and throws them at enemies. Renamons can jump very high and their bodies are their greatest weapon thanks to their claws, strong legs and tail. Intelligence how to use their skills and abilities only makes them one of the strongest "Rookie" level Digimon out there.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Renamon in "Digital World 3.3" are not as plentiful as one would think but they usually get very good at tasks they do to the point its hard not to hear about them from locals. Most Renamons in the "Digital World 3.3" live at the "Suzaku Temple" and its surroundings and are part of the "Renren Clan" but there are few who are living in other parts of the world on their own focusing on other skills rather than martial arts.

In most Digital Worlds, Renamon wear purple sleeves, but in "Digital World 3.3" they usually pick one color of the sleeves which fits their personality. Renamon are Data type Digimon but many people still mistook them for a Vaccine Type.

entries.name: Mummymon
entries.content:
Mummymon Almost entire body is covered in bandages leaving only some of its body parts visible. Got very dry old grayish skin. Only left eye is visible as other is covered by bandages. Wears vest made of strong black leather belts on which he holds its weapons. Got black spikes on his shoulders. Long claws on its toes. Skinny hands with long fingers and long sharp claws. Many black leather belts with metal on its arms and legs. Rotten looking teeth. Mummymon Wears Purple bandana on its head. Beside Bandana and belts it doesn't wear nothing ever as bandages it got are never changed and cover most of the skin on the body

Digimon Type: "Virus" 
Digimon Level: "Ultimate"

Mummymon is considered undead Digimon with many tricks despite its looks. Some say it can lay upon temporary curses but Mummymon often uses its gun and famous skill such as Snake Bandage which Coils the bandages on both of its arms around the opponent, like a snakes. Mummymon also tends to smell bad.

entries.name: Sorcerymon
entries.content:
Sorcerymon looks like an icy and holy version of Wizard-Mon, shifting its color palette to white and light blue. Its hat lacks the large skull on Wizard-mon's, while its staff is snowflake-shaped compared to Wizard-mon's sun, reflecting its water and ice powers. The DigiCode on its cape are randomly arranged, and read "Digital Monster".

Digimon Type: "Vaccine" 
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Sorcerymon magic is orientated around ice, illusion and a bit of holy magic but can be more depending on its interests.

Most famous ability moves are "Crystal Barrage" which shoot multiple ice creations from its staff. and "Ice Illusion" which Entraps enemy in a freezing snowstorm. Sorcerymon is very weak up close so Sorcerymon prefers long range battle over anything. Some say Sorcerymon is a glass cannon of a Digimon mostly due being a wizard Digimon.

entries.name: Seraphimon
entries.content:
Seraphimon is a big looking angel Digimon. Three pairs of golden holy wings. Human like shape. Silver Paladin Armor with golden decorations. Cloth belt addon with holy symbols. Azure and Silver Shoulder Pauldrons. Silver Helmet with Golden four point Star in center and yellow fur frill. Silver heavy gauntlets and boots. Despite the fact helmet and armor hide every bit of skin and cover face, Seraphimon can clearly see and hear thru it.  It is dressed in holy armor that shines silver, and possesses ten golden wings. As the highest-ranked being among Angel Digimon, it rules over them all. Although its true identity and personality are hidden behind a mask and cannot be glimpsed

Digimon Type: "Vaccine" 
Digimon Level: "Mega"

Seraphimon is a very powerful holy Digimon with many unique attacks which dont always involve his golden sword. "Strike of the Seven Stars" is its most famous and powerful attack as it fires seven super-heated spheres of light at the opponent. Which usually is super effective against dark forces or virus Digimon. He is a holy angel Digimon who many also see as a Celestial Digimon. Seraphimon can fly quite well with his wings despite the very heavy and durable armor he got. Its other attacks are "Hallowed Knuckle", "Rising Halo" and a "Recovery" which is a healing move but it costs a lot of energy.

entries.name: Mikemon
entries.content:
Mikemon appears similar to an Egyptian cat with the Calico cat breed's white, orange tabby and black coloration wearing large reddish brown and brown striped gloves with tan claws sticking out of them. Its ears are large with tufts of reddish brown hair on the tips reminiscent of a caracal. Its tail is reddish brown with orange stripes with a tuft on the end. Mikemon different color variation than their counter parts, they are not considered holy beasts and Mikemon lacks a Holy Ring on the tail which Gato-mons have.

Mikemon is a Beast cat Digimon and its strong but small Digimon.

Digimon Type: "Data" 
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Some Mikemon have a bit different patterns but most seem to be sharing same design. Mikemons are very rare Digimon in the "Digital World 3.3"

Famous attack abilities of Mikemon are "Paw Punch" or "Cat Claw". Mikemons are agile and strong despite their size.

entries.name: Devimon
entries.content:
Devimon is a Fallen Angel Digimon. Its body is clad in jet-black cloth. Devimon is a humanoid Digimon. It draws inspiration from the mythological Devil and evil in general. It has completely black clothing, fingers elongated into claws, devil's horns, tattered wings, and skulls on its shoulder and knee. It has the deep red Mark of Evil on its chest and on its left boot. It also wears belts around its lower torso, left leg, right upper arm and left forearm, gauze bandages around its right forearm and left hand, and a skin-tight balaclava that only reveals its mouth and red glowing eyes.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Devimon are usually very intelligent and full of tricks and surprises. They can fly and often prefer to use others to do dirty work. Despite being a Champion level Digimon, Devimon is very strong even for this level standards. Most famous abilities and attacks are "Touch of Evil" Extends both of his extensible, elongated arms even further, and enforces his will on the opponent's body and mind if their will is weak enough. "Death Hand" Unleashes a blast of unholy energy from his hands. "Deadly Nail" Scratches enemies using the nails on both hands. "Dark Mist" casts a mist of Darkness to limit opponent vision.

entries.name: Meicoomon
entries.content:
Meicoomon is an Unknown Digimon cat like. Meicoomon is characterized by its large ears and tail. Despite being hard to imagine, based on its fluffy coat of fur and adorable appearance, it actually possesses extremely sharp claws underneath its paws. Other than hiding its shy face, the two feelers growing from Meicoomon's neck are also excellent to use as a scarf during cold times. Meicoomon are small and may look weak but they are very powerful Digimon. Meicoomon's design is derived from the Maine Coon. It is a bipedal cat-like creature with orange fur on most of its body, and white on its snout, paws, and inner ears, as well as a white mane. It has many black spots on its head fur. Meicoomon has green eyes with cross-shaped pupils, that turn red with X shaped pupils when threatened. It also has a tail, and two scarf-like appendages on each neck. Both the tail and the scarf-like appendages have multiple black "X" on it, and X-shaped protrusion on its end. It also has white hexagonal crystals with golden borders on its fore legs. Meicoomon are extremely rare Digimon in many Digital Worlds due to their code being still new and not many Digimon eggs containing Digimon who can Digivolve into Meicoomon did spawn yet.

Digimon Type: technically its a "Free" type but many consider Meicoomon to be "Virus" due to their powers
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Meicoomon are small and fast but in raw power they can match many champion level Digimon and even take few of said Digimon at once in battle. Meicoomon most famous attacks and abilities are "X Scratch" Scratches enemies with her long claws. "Trichobezoar" Spits out a hairball from her mouth that damages Digimon data. "Scarf Smack" uses her scarf-like appendages for a brutal smacking combo.

entries.name: Gotsumon
entries.content:
Gotsumon is a humanoid Digimon with a body made of gray rocks. It has yellow eyes and two rocks on its head that resemble bear ears. It has three fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot. Gotsumon is a very Durable and strong Digimon but a bit slow when it comes to running.

Digimon Type: "Type"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Gotsumon often relay on heavy defense and sometimes group tactics. Gotsumon attacks are "Rock Fist", "Angry Rock" which shoots extremely hard ore from its head.
"Wild Strike" Swings its arms wildly while moving towards the enemy. "Earth Shaker" A pillar made of rock emerges from the ground.

entries.name: Angewomon
entries.content:
Angewomon is a tall, slender, woman-like Digimon with fair skin, long blonde hair, and a silver helmet like that of Angemon. Its outfit is a skin-tight, white bodysuit that covers half of its body with white high heels, and it wears the Ten'ne characteristic of Tennin. It has eight white, dove-like wings with four on either side. Angewomon wears a Holy Ring on its left ankle and the DigiCode on both the Holy Ring and the ends of its ten'ne reads "Digital Monster". Angewomon is an Archangel Digimon. It has the appearance of a beautiful woman. Although it was previously classified as an Angel-type, it was confirmed as an Archangel-type because of the greatness of its abilities.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Ultimate"

Angewomon is very skilled angelic warrior who got many skills. She often uses her ability to fly to gain advantage. Her most famous attack is the "Celestial Arrow" which is a holy arrow made of holy lightning. Other attack are "Holy Slap" which is just regular slap but word holy makes it sound more cool. "Angel Dash" and "Heaven's Charm"

entries.name: Dokugumon
entries.content:
Dokugumon is an insectoid Digimon spider. Dokugumon is a big spider Digimon with evil looking face. He got nine eyes which look green shiny orbs. When it is mad or uses its powers the eyes turn into red color and glow bright. It got long horns on sides of his head. Six spider Legs and each got different bandages or wraps around it. Its mouth is huge and got sharp teeth and venomous fangs. Small head compared to huge spider abdomen which is black with the white coloration on top of it in shape of skull and bones. It got short hands on front of his body very close to head.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Dokugumons are sneaky and sometimes work in big groups. Dokugumon attack abilities are as follows, "Poison Cobweb" Fires a poisonous blast from its mouth. "Poison Thread" Shoots a web from its spinnerets. "Poison Sting" Attacks with a sharp poisonous needle. "Combo Kick" spins and kicks target with all six of its legs.

entries.name: Angemon
entries.content:
Angemon is an Angel Digimon. It has six shining wings, and its body is clad in cloth so pure white as to be divine. It is a being of perfected virtue, and although it is called a Digimon that brings happiness, when confronting evil, it does not stop attacking, with extreme composure, until the opponent is completely beaten. On the countless times when the Digital World is visited by a crisis, it is told that Angemons descends to fight alongside other holy Digimon to protect the order of the Digital World. Angemon draws inspiration from the mythological Angel, particularly the pop culture version. Humanoid in body and covered in holy white clothing, it has six, white, feathery wings commonly associated with angels. It has long blond hair, and its upper face is covered with a silver mask that has the Christian cross. The DigiCode on its ribbons reads "Digital Monster". It also wears a long blue loincloth and four matching straps on its right leg and left arm attached. Angemons always carry a golden like rod or staff.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Angemon can be strong alone but prefer to have allies if needed but will protect its friends and protect the order. Angemon likes to fly. Angemon famous attacks and abilities are "Hand of Fate" Strikes the opponent with its fist shining gold which also may fire a beam of energy from its fist if enemy is evil or a virus type Digimon. "Angel Rod" Attacks with its Angel Rod. "Omni Typhoon" Creates a divine tornado. "Angel Slam" Uses Holy Rod to pick up an enemy and slam them into the ground.

entries.name: Gabumon
entries.content:
Gabumon is a yellow-skinned lizard in a bluish-white pelt with navy blue markings and purple claws, which is fashioned from data left behind by Garuru-mon. A yellow horn protrudes at the top of its head and its belly is blue with unusual pink markings. Gabumon is a Reptile Digimon but some like to call Gabumon a Lizard dog even if its not accurate. Although Gabumon it is covered by a fur pelt, it is still clearly a Reptile Digimon. Gabumons wear the Garuru-Mon pelt often for not only warmth or protection but also because it became sort of a tradition and it does look cute on them. Pelt covers the head and most of the face hiding real looks under it.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Gabumons known abilities and attacks are "Blue Blaster" Releases a stream of blue ice-like flames from its mouth. "Upper Claw" Knocks the enemy into the air with an upward swing of the claws on both hands. "Horn Attack" uses its horn to stab an enemy.

entries.name: Tentomon
entries.content:
Tentomon is an Insectoid Digimon. It is the original type of Insectoid Digimon who, although it has a hard shell it is not a best fighting Digimon in its current form. It has one hard claw on each of its fore-legs, and four on each of its middle- and hind-legs, and in particular, the middle-legs are able to skillfully grasp objects just like a human hand. Tentomon's design is derived from the ladybug (Coccinella septempunctata). It is a bipedal Digimon with four arms with the first pair each ending in a single grey talon. It has large, green eyes, mouth-like mandibles, and two yellow antennae reaching out from its head. Its elytra is covered with grey spines. It is red and brownish green in coloration with black muscle in the face, neck, the brachium of its arms, and its thighs.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Tentomon can fly but is not fastest at it. Tentomon most famous abilities and attacks are "Super Shocker" Hurls static electricity that it amplified with its wings. "Talon Attack" Attacks the enemy with a hard claw. "Body Blow" Tackles the enemy. "Double Punch" Slices the enemy with both claws. "Rolling Guard" Spins along the ground and slams into the opponent.

entries.name: Candlemon
entries.content:
Candlemon is a Flame Digimon. There is a flame on its head that resembles DemiMeramon, and if that flame goes out, it dies. Or at least many say so but no one did try this in practice. Because of this, some say that the main body is the flame and that the wax is just a decoy. Candelmon body is made of living Wax. Its red Eyes and mouth are huge. It does not have legs but instead of them there's a candle stand made of golden looking like metal. Top of the head got a living flame on it which always burns and looks like a mini face of a Mera-mon. Candelmon body is shaped overall like a big living candle and top of his head instead of hair got melted wax shaped like a haircut. Some call Candelmon the Candmon as its other name by which this species goes by.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Candelmon can levitate but cant fly too high. Its body is quite fragile but long range fire and wax attacks are quite effective making Candelmon still quite dangerous. Candelmon famous attacks and abilities are "Lava Loogie" Fires a small flame from its DigiCore fire energy that explode if hits. "Paraffin Paralyzer" Fires multiple globs of hot wax to trap opponent in it. "Candle Ring" Emits an incredible beam of light. "Tackle" Uses its body to tackle the enemy.

entries.name: Snow Goburimon
entries.content:
SnowGoburimon is a light blue goblin-like Digimon with blue eyes and pointy ears. It has two large teeth in its mouth, five fingers on each hand and five toes on each foot. It wears a pierced ring on its left ear and a brown sleeveless jacket with light brown trim and pom-pom like buttons that has light brown leather adorned by metal orbs near its shoulders. It also wears a black helmet with light brown trim and a spike on top. SnowGoburimon carries a wooden club with screws on it, and a metallic ornament under its hilt. Sometimes Snowgoburimon wears fur shoes and sometimes it walks bare foot.

Level: "Rookie"
Digimon Type: "Virus"

SnowGoburimon is cold resistant and weak to fire. SnowGoburimons known attacks are "SnowGob Bolt" It uses snowballs with stones embedded in them, and with full strength strikes the enemy. "SnowGob Breath" Breathes out freezing cold air to encase the foe in thin ice layer. "Snow Gobu Mace" Hits the foe with his club. "Snow Claw" Slashes enemy with high speed.

SnowGoburimons are known to be aggressive and Mischievous but also cowardly if alone and most of time they are in groups. Often working for bigger stronger Digimon to lead them.

The non-cold weather variant of SnowGoburimon is simply called Goburimon and its green skined.

entries.name: Ogremon
entries.content:
Ogremon is a Demon Digimon. It is a Demon Digimon resembling an Oni in Japanese folklore. The attacks it carries out with its muscles have tremendous destructive power. It has a high intelligence, but a rough temper, the driving force behind its destructive anger. It is very belligerent, and is referred to as the "Digimon Hunter" due to seeking to fight bold Digimon with as much combat power as itself. It carries a bone club that is said to be a femur of a favorite slain opponent. Ogremon is a Digimon that resembles a green ogre with long, unkempt white hair, pointed ears adored by earrings, two horns on its head and spikes jutting from its shoulders. It's known for having its mouth open nearly all the time with an exaggerated lower jaw similar to Violator and has fang-like tusks on its upper jaw like a traditional Oni. It wears a black loincloth with a belt, a bracer on its right arm, red bandages on both its left arm and right leg and black belts on its left leg. It carries a large, spiked femur bone as a bludgeon weapon. It has a skull and crossbones on its left arm below its shoulder spikes, metal studs on the knuckles of its left hand, and a scar on the back of its right hand.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Ogremon is pure raw power and they quite decent size. Not too big but big enough to look intimidating. Ogremon famous attacks and abilities are "Pummel Whack" Fires dark energy from its fist. "Bone Mace" Whacks enemies with its club. "Faint Punch" punches to weaken enemy rather than to hurt them.

entries.name: Dorumon
entries.content:
Dorumon is a beast-like Digimon with purple fur on most of its body. It has two large legs and two arms, each of which has three black claws, as well as a large, vulpine tail. The fur on its chest, paws, snout, and the end of its tail is white. It has two pointed ears with black stripes and two very small black wings. On its brow is a triangular red gem.

Dorumons look like raptor Digimon but with fur instead of scales. It got adorable looks but under all this adorable and cute appearance there is a very strong Digimon.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Most known Abilities are "Dash Metal" Fires an iron sphere from its mouth while charging. "Metal Cannon" Stands still and accumulates power, then fires a more powerful iron sphere from its mouth. "Metal Shoot" Emits a small blast from the mouth. "Beast Attack" Attacks with a swift blow of a powerful claw attacks.

entries.name: Goburimon
entries.content:
Goburimon is also known as Goblimon

Goburimon is a green goblin-like Digimon with yellow eyes, short red mohawk hair, and pointy ears. It has two large teeth in its mouth, five fingers on each hand and five toes on each foot. It wears a pierced ring on its left ear and a light brown sleeveless jacket that is open with brown trim and has black leather adorned by metal orbs near its shoulders. It also wears a brown belt and a light brown loincloth. Goburimon carries a wooden club with screws on it, and a metallic ornament under its hilt. Almost always goes bare foot

Goburimons are known to be aggressive and Mischievous but also cowardly if alone and most of time they are in groups. Often working for bigger stronger Digimon to lead them.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Cold region variants of Goburimon is called SnowGoburimon.

Goburimon attacks and abilities are "Goburi Strike" Throws a fireball at the opponent at fast speed from the tip of its club. "Goburi Rush" Makes multiple attacks with a club. "Boulder Throw" Summons a large boulder and throws it.

entries.name: Numemon
entries.content:
Numemon is a Mollusk Digimon. It possesses a slug-like body, prefers dark, gloomy environments, and has neither offensive power nor intelligence. A Digimon becomes a Numemon if mistakes are made in raising it or simply is very unlucky with its natural Digivolution which will lead it to become a Numemon.

Numemon which is a green slug with big eyes  balls on top of his body, He got blue spots on its back, His mouth got huge teeth and a tongue. His mouth is taking over half of his body. It has arms are very short and look more like tentacles that are usually retracted inside its body. His eyes have red pupils. Numemons don't have actual legs so Numemon moves like a slug using slimy underpart of his body.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Many Digimon find Numemons Disgusting and foul and assume they are evil since they often cause chaos but the last part is a lie as many Numemons can be kind if a bit hard to control and often are ready to sacrifice themselves to help others in Digital World bring peace.

Due to fact Numemons are often very small Digimon and lack both strength and intelligence despite being a Champion Level Digimon. They find their strength in numbers and often live and travel in huge groups.

Numemons next level Digivolutions often make them more fancy and slightly more stronger and smarter but even at their peak they are nothing special which makes them often a laughing stock of Digital World.

Numemons are infamous for their poop throwing attacks. Also their other attacks are "Nume-Sludge" Throws his own poop at enemy in order to defend himself. "Junk Throw" "Super Stinky Spray" Emits a disgusting smell with a burp. "Nume Charge" Charges with a slippery body. "Yucky Tongue" Licks the enemy in a disgusting way.

Numemons are attracted to dar, damp locations such as sewers and caves.

entries.name: Black-Gatomon
entries.content:
Black-Gatomon is a Dark Beast Digimon which looks like a small cat wearing large Purple and red striped gloves with black claws sticking out of them. Ears are large with tufts of purple hair on the tips reminiscent of a caracal. Tail has purple stripes with a tuft on the end. Black Paw Pads. Usually Yellow eyes. Black Fur covers their entire body. Black-Gatomons have their holy variant version which is white and of Vaccine type.

Black-Gatomon most common abilities and moves are "Neko Punch", "Tail Whip" and "Flurry of Fury". Some Black-Gatomons can also use "Cat's Eye Hypnotism" but its a move many of them cant learn or simply forget they can use it. Overall Black-Gatomon relay on their speed, small size body and sharp fangs, claws and long tails and trickery if needed during battles.

Digimon Level of a Black-Gatomon is "Champion".
Black-Gatomons are a "Virus Type" Digimon

Black-Gatomon are also known under name "Black-Tailmon".
Despite their small size the Black-Gatomons are considered to be Dark Beasts.

In "Digital World 3.3" Both Black-Gatomons and Gatomons can be encountered anywhere in the world and its a custom for many of them to run Hotels, INNs, Shops or Small Businesses.

BlackGatomons are not too aggressive but by nature they are a bit mischievous and sassy

entries.name: Herissmon
entries.content:
Herissmon is a bipedal Digimon that resembles a hedgehog. It has light blue eyes, a black snout, ears, white fur, large red claws, and a small tail. Its feet have two digits, and its hand have three. Herissmon's thumbs are its only clawless digits. Herissmon has a zigzag-shaped mouth and yellow marks on its belly and under its eyes. It also has grey spiky—mimicking a hedgehog's spikes—on its back, around its neck, under its ears, on the back of its head, and from the top of its head until its snout. The larger strings of fur on the top of its head are yellow, and fur under its ears also has yellow tips.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Herissmon attacks are "Lightning Quills" Attacks the opponent by shooting lightning-coated quills. "Needle-Point Dive" Curls its body up into a ball and charges forth.

entries.name: Ponchomon
entries.content:
Ponchomon resembles a Haniwa-faced cactus. It wears an orange poncho, a sombrero with maracas in it and a pair of boxing gloves. Sharp two rows of teeth. Eyes look like empty dark eyeholes. Entire body is made out of cactus so it got many spikes and its lime green. Doesn't have legs but can he can fly. Very long tongue. Ponchomon is mostly plant made but it got some of ghostly like abilities such as ability to fly.

Digivolved into Ponchomon  thru the Digi-Egg of Sincerity.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Armor Digivolution"

Ponchomon attacks are "Tequila Knuckle" Driving punches that only hit the opponent's face with its leather-strapped fists, intoxicating them with its destructive power. "Blood Dance" Strikes the opponent while getting into a rhythm with the maracas on his Mexican hat. "Cactus Blast" fires powerful fire blast out of his mouth.

entries.name: Tapirmon
entries.content:
Tapirmon also known as Bakumon. Tapirmon's design is derived from the Malayan Tapir and the mythical, dream-eating baku of Japanese mythology. It is a tapir-like Digimon with brown and purple fur, blue eyes, and two tusks. It has a smoke in place of legs, making it resemble a genie. It wears a Holy Ring on its left-leg and a gray metallic helmet with golden symbols in it.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Tapirmon famous attacks are "Nightmare Syndrome" Releases his captured nightmares all at once, drowning the opponent in terror. "Deleting Virus" removes corruption from target and if its a Virus type Digimon it greatly weakens it for quite a while. "Holy Shoot" Causes an explosion with a small ball of light. "Sleep Mist" envelops target in mist which may put them in sleep.

entries.name: Bakemon
entries.content:
Bakemon is a levitating ghost covered in a white cloth that hides his true form, leaving only his mouth filled with sharp teeth to be seen and black eyes glowing gold in the center of them with unholy light. His true form hands got purple skin and black claws. 

Bakemon can become immune to physical attacks and charms but can be effected by energy or elemental infused attacks. Its very weak against light/Holy type of attacks. Despite being a champion level Digimon, Bakemon is not very strong and needs to depend on its unique and creative use of its abilities rather than brute strength. Bakemons often but not always work in groups and depend on trickery. 

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Bakemon can fly, become ethereal to physical attacks or to pass walls. The attacks and abilities attacks are "Dark Claw" Scratches opponent with his claws infused in dark magic. "Evil Charm" Casts a powerful possession spell which allows him to posses his target for a while unless they got strong will. "Ghost Chop" conjures small ghostly  axes and throws them at enemy. "Poison Breath" Blows out poisonous smoke to weaken his opponents

entries.name: Phantomon
entries.content:
Phantomon is a levitating Phantom that wears a red hooded cape to conceal its face and is covered in a grey cloth that hides its true form. It wields a scythe-like sickle and chain which coupled with the hood makes it resemble the mythological Grim Reaper. Its hood has a skull and hazard symbol on it and he wears a chain necklace with a crystal shaped like an eyeball attached to it.

Phantomons are often found leading groups of Bakemons and if they don't they usually are quite full of tricks if they prefer to work alone.

Phantomons can be immune to the physical attacks by becoming ethereal. But they can be hurt still even in etheral form by energy or elemental attacks. Especially by holy/light attacks.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Ultimate"

Phantomons can fly and become ethereal if they need to go thru walls or avoid physical attacks. Phantomon attacks are "Evil Charm" Casts a powerful possession spell which allows him to posses his target for a while unless they got strong will. "Ghost Chop" conjures small ghostly  axes and throws them at enemy. "Shadow Scythe" Cuts even the opponent's soul to pieces with its gigantic sickle and chain, causing a lot of spiritual damage before targets soul returns to normal. "Diabolic Star" Calls dark energy into the weighted chain end of his sickle and chain and slams an opponent with it.

entries.name: Nefertimon
entries.content:
Nefertimon is a mix of Gatomon and a sphinx, seemingly combining traits from the Egyptian and Greek versions of the creature. It armor-digivolved through the power of the "Digi-Egg of Light". Nefertimon body reminiscent of a female lion, with powerful, armored front legs and massive claws. Large, white wings that add to her mythical appearance. Her head is adorned with a headdress and a calm, stoic face that evokes ancient Egyptian art. Tail is tipped with a tuft of dark purple fur, contrasting with her overall lighter color palette. Her body fur is white. Nefertimon walks on all four and got Huge Sharp Claws especially on front paws. Nefertimon can fly thanks to the big wings.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Armor-Digivolution"

"Tail Whip" where she lash out with her tail as a finishing move. Can Fly using her huge wings. "Rosetta Stone" Summons a megalith with ancient inscriptions engraved in DigiCode to attack the enemy. "Queen's Paw" Fires jewels from the bracers on paws. "Cat's Eye Beam" Produces a red, high-temperature beam from the ornament on her brow. "Queen's Paw" Fires jewels from its leg armor.

entries.name: Kyubimon
entries.content:
Kyubimon is a Yellow nine-tailed Fox with a white chest fur and mystical blue flames flaring around its paws and tail tips. Large Yin-Yang symbol on forehead. Blue marks under eyes. Blue Eyes. Nine tails with blur fire on end of their tips. Long fox ears. Black shiny nose. Wears Red and White striped ribbon with golden bells on the ends on her front legs and neck. Kubimon runs on all four legs. Kyubimon body is big enough that it can be mounted.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Kyubimon attacks are "Dragon Wheel" Creates a burning dragon out of blue flames from her tails and shoots it at the enemy. "Fox Tail Inferno" Causing onibi to manifest, and manipulates them according to her will. "Headbutt" Charges and attacks with the head.

entries.name: Taomon
entries.content:
Taomon is a humanoid Digimon with fox-like characteristics. It wears a white onmyōji robe with vertical plates on the shoulders, the Sanskrit character for "Hūṃ" emblazoned on the front, the yin-yang symbol on the chest and shoulder plates (beneath three red wisps in the latter instance), and red and white triangles on the ends of the sleeves. It also wears baggy purple pants, and a tall, black and purple hat. It has white, three-fingered hands and white, three-toed feet with black claws and black paw pads in both instances. It has a yellow furred tail with a white tip, and a yellow, fox-like face with purple markings on its cheeks and forehead and white-tipped ears. It also has black eyes with indigo irises.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Ultimate"

Taomon attacks are "Talisman of Light" Chants the incantation Bon-Hitsu-Sen while painting the Sanskrit character in the air with its gigantic brush, then hurls it at the opponent to catch them in a gigantic explosion and annihilate them. "Fox-seal Scrolls" Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them. "Brush Stroke" Uses a large brush to hit the enemy.

entries.name: Sakuyamon
entries.content:
Sakuyamon Sakuyamon is a tall humanoid Digimon. Most of its body is covered in black, skin-tight fabric. It wears knee-high, purple and yellow boots with the yin-yang symbol on the instep, and purple and yellow gauntlets with the yin-yang symbol displayed on the backs of the hands. It also wears a yellow cuirass and shoulder guards, the latter of which have the yin-yang symbol emblazoned upon them, and a yellow, traditional kitsune-style half mask which obscures its human-like face. It also has ankle-length silver hair tied into pigtails, and carries a long, gold staff with several rings adorning the tip called Kongou Shakujou. Its gloves bear the Zero Unit. It always carries "Kongou Shakujou" staff with it.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Mega"

Sakuyamon attacks are "Spirit Strike" Attacks the opponent with the four kuda-gitsune carried on her waist. "Twin Blades of Beauty and of Truth" Uses the Kongou Shakujou to create two pink rings of energy around herself which form a barrier of cherry blossom petals. "Crystal Sphere" Creates a spherical barrier around herself. "Amethyst Wind" Unleashes a storm of purifying cherry blossoms. "Fox Drive" Destroy the enemy with a burning blue flame.
"Thunder Kick" Drops down like lightning from the sky and attacks with a kick.
"Fox Card" Throws a card and seals the enemy's power. "Amethyst Mandala" Strikes the ground with the Kongou Shakujou, spreading a purifying barrier that exorcises evil spirits.

entries.name: Togemon
entries.content:
Togemon's body resembles a giant Haniwa-faced cactus, with a tuft of orange hair wearing a pair of red boxing gloves. Togemon body is very big, bright green and covered in spikes. Only clothing Togemon wears are the red boxing gloves which he never takes off. Its eyes and mouth look like deep dark void filled with darkness.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Togemon attacks are "Needle Spray" Spins around and shoots thorns and needles at the foe or further hardens the thorns on the end of his arms and bang-bang strikes the opponent. "Powerful Punch" uses his boxing skills to land a powerful punch at opponent face with his fists and continues with combo attack.

entries.name: Guardromon
entries.content:
Guardromon  is a Robot Digimon. He looks like a walking boiler tank with a pressure door and a valve on his front. His is looking bulky with all his meta parts. His head is part of his torso and so it does not have a neck. His head is small and looks like a helmet made of scrap with robotic eyes glowing inside the darkness of his helmet like head. He got short but bulky legs and long thin arms but with massive hands and shoulders. On back he got two exhaustion pipes and many vents to release heat on front. His whole body is made of metal and its in brown color with copper like detailing's. He looks also old and rusty but still functional. Green colored glass Eyes which can glow and shoot lasers and can emit light. His mouth is a speaker under the armor. Does not need to eat, drink nor even sleep.

Digimon Type: "Virus"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

"Grenade Destroyer" Fires whistling missiles from the retractable missile launchers in his forearms. "Warning Laser" lasers from his eyes.

entries.name: Biyomon
entries.content:
Biyomon is a Bird Digimon. Its wings have developed to become like arms and it is able to dexterously operate them and use them to grip objects, but for that reason, it is poor at flying through the air. It usually lives on the ground, but when danger draws near, it escapes by flying away. However, since its flying ability is not best the Biyomon  is quite slow with flying fast or high without getting tired. Biyomon is a pink bird with arm-like wings, a feather mane, a red beak, blue stripes on its crest, blue borders on two of its head feathers and its tail feathers, yellow legs, and red claws on its wings and feet. It wears a metallic ring on its left leg. Blue eyeballs with black irises.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Biyomon attacks are "Spiral Twister" summons a twister of green weak flame to hit her enemy. "Peak Attack" uses her peak to hurt enemy.

entries.name: Gaomon
entries.content:
Gaomon is a bipedal blue Akita dog with black nose and claws, yellow eyes, a white belly, white neck fur, a white tail tip, feet tips, snout, inner ears, and a linear mark on their forehead that is depicted as either white or yellow. They wear a red bandana, with white bandages on their arms, and red, black, and white boxing gloves on their hands. All Gaomons are naturally good fighters who use boxing or mixed fighting styles with boxing.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Gaomon attacks are "Rolling Upper" Exploits his tenacious leg strength and rolls into the opponent's chest. "Double Backhand" Unleashes a strike while spinning. "Gao Rush" Moves nimbly to unleash a high-speed barrage of punches.

entries.name: Armadillomon
entries.content:
Armadillomon is a small glyptodont-like Digimon with three-clawed limbs and a short tail. It is primarily yellow with a purple underside. Green eyes. Very small body size and can roll into its own armor and take shape of a ball. Is quite fast despite its small size. Walks on all four but can help itself using its front paws almost like hands if needed. Quite durable and looks like armadillo.

Digimon Type: "Free"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Armadillomon attacks "Diamond Shell" Curls up its body and rushes the opponent. "Beat Blaster" Strikes the opponent with the elongated claws on its forelegs. "Hard Brick" rolls into a ball and uses his natural armor for defense.

entries.name: Agumon
entries.content:
Agumon is a short and stout Tyrannosaurus rex-like Digimon standing about 3 feet tall, and has amber orange skin and light green eyes. It also has flattened forearms with broad, three-clawed hands, though early artwork for the Digimon virtual pet depicted its hands with four claws, and distinct pectoral muscles. Its legs and arms are shown to be very vascular. Its tail is stubby, and its head and snout are almost as large as the rest of its body. Sharp teeth. Lizard looking face. Green Eyes. Big hands and feet with four short fingers and toes but with long white claws. Short yellow tail. his nose is two nostrils spread far away from each other on front of his muzzle. Round belly

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Agumon attacks are "Pepper Breath" Spits flame breath from its mouth to attack the opponent. "Claw Attack" Rapidly jabs or slashes the opponent with the claws of both hands. "Big Bite" bites enemy with his bit mouth full of sharp teeth

entries.name: Greymon
entries.content:
Greymon is a bipedal reptilian Digimon whose design carries elements of the Ceratosaurus and the classic monster Gomora. It has orange scales with blue stripes covering its body. It has three clawed fingers on its hands and three clawed toes on its feet, with claws protruding from its heels. It wears a dark brown rhinoceros beetle-like skull on its head. Greymon is quite big and strong Digimon even for a Champion level standards and can take a beating before it feels tired from battle. Brown Eyes.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Champion"

Greymon attacks are "Nova Blast" Spews ultra-high-temperature flames or a flame shot from his mouth to reduce everything to ashes. "Great Horns Attack" Impales the opponent on his horns. "Tail Smack" uses his big tail to punch enemy with big impact.

entries.name: MetalGreymon
entries.content:
MetalGreymon is a Cyborg Digimon. It has mechanized more than half of its body. MetalGreymon is a bipedal reptilian Digimon whose design carries elements of the Ceratosaurus and the classic monster Gomora albeit mechanized resulting in it having missile hatches on its chest and robotic mechanisms under it skin which are partially exposed on its tail. It has three clawed fingers on its hands and three clawed toes on its feet, with claws protruding from its heels. It wears a metallic rhinoceros beetle-like helmet on its head with red hair underneath on the back of its head and its left arm is robotic with a tether connecting its hand. It has purple tattered wings on its back making MetalGreymon able to fly or at least use those wings to get to higher places easier. MetalGreymon is Retaining the coloring of Greymon. Moreover, it has dark brown horns and blue eyes.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Ultimate"

MetalGreymon attacks are "Mega Claw" Launches its tethered Trident Arm to slash or wrap up enemies. "Giga Blaster" Fires organic missiles from the hatch on part of its chest. "Metal Slash" Slashes with its claw.

entries.name: Patamon
entries.content:
Patamon is a Mammal Digimon. It is characterized by its large ears, and is able to fly through the air by using them as large wings, but because it only goes at a speed of 1 kph, it is said that it is definitely faster walking. However, it's very popular because its appearance is cute when it is desperately flying. Patamon is a small flying creature resembling a guinea pig (Cavia porcellus) with light blue eyes, bat-like wings which could possibly be its ears, and a short, stubby tail. Its underside is a light cream color, while its back and head are orange.

Digimon Type: "Data"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

Patamon attacks are "Boom Bubble" Sucks in air then spews an air shot out in one burst. "Body Blow" Tackles the enemy but its a weak attack because Patamon is small and light weight. "Thousand Wings" Spins in the air to attack the enemy with his ears.

entries.name: WarGreymon
entries.content:
WarGreymon is a Dragon Digimon. The strongest dragon warrior whose body is clad in armor of the super-metal "Chrome Digizoid". Though it differs from the gigantic figure seen in Greymon-species Digimon, and has the form of a Man-type, it has rapidly improved its speed and power, and it is likely impossible to defeat it with the attacks of an lower level Digimon. WarGreymon is a tall reptilian Digimon with a humanoid body structure. Like other Greymon-species Digimon, it has Tyrannosaurus rex-like features (such as its feet and the shape of its head), but unlike other Greymon-species Digimon, its back is not angled, giving it a human-like posture. It has orange scales covering most of its body; the only exception is its face, which is covered in grey metal, with one spike on its nose, two spikes behind its eyes, and spiky red hair on the back of its head. The shin guards, cuirass, and spiked yellow shoulder pads it wears are held in place by thick, red cable-like ropes. It holds two large, yellow three-clawed gauntlets in its hands. The Brave Shield it carries on its back is emblazoned with the Crest of Courage.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Mega"

WarGreymon attacks are "Terra Force" Takes all of the energy within the atmosphere and concentrates it into one spot, then fires it as an extremely dense, high-temperature energy shot. "Great Tornado" Spins at tremendous speed like a tornado and launches himself at the enemy. "Brave Shield" Uses his back shield to defend.

entries.name: Ryudamon
entries.content:
Ryudamon is a small Dragon Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. Because it has an old-style Interface on its brow, it is presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. Although its body is clad in Japanese-style armor high in defensive ability, its movements are nimble, so it fights by resolutely leaping into the opponent's chest. Ryudamon takes the Shogi theme of its line to its logical conclusion, actually becoming the dragon that is the literal name of the Promoted Rook ("Dragon King") chess piece. It wears Japanese-style armor emphasize its Japanese nature. Skin color is of light orange hue. Three fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot. All ending with short but sharp white claws. Green eyes. Short Lizard Tail. Ryudamon is about half size of adult human.

Digimon Type: "Vaccine"
Digimon Level: "Rookie"

"Kabutogaeshi" Withstands the opponent's attacks with its armor and helmet, then counterattacks. "Katana Attack" Leaps into the opponent's chest and fires a blade of iron shaped like katana from its mouth.
